submission.body:
All three shares verified:

- **group_b** moved `readDependencies` and `findCycle` (with `CycleNode`) into `src/decision/dependencies.ts`.
- **group_a** (me) moved `parseUnit` (renamed `parseDriverItem`) with `DriverItemSpec` into `src/decision/units.ts`.
- **group_c** moved `mintUnits`, `finalizeMintedUnits`, `MintedUnit`, `DriverUnit`, and their helpers (`envelopes`, `selectInputsForUnit`, `outputSlots`, `selectDriverArtifacts`, `bindingPath`, `sourceArtifactId`) into `src/decision/mint.ts`, merging the two fan-out loops into one.

`derive.ts` now only imports and orchestrates. No stale references remain (no `parseUnit`, `DriverParseSpec`, `readDependencies`, `findCycle`, `mintUnits`, `finalizeMintedUnits`, or `DriverUnit` in derive.ts body). `byString` is duplicated in derive.ts and dependencies.ts but each is private to its file — no issue.

tsc clean, 29/29 tests pass.
